description: Adds a TikTok or YouTube Shorts post the user published themselves to their heistclips ledger, matched to a campaign by id, so to_submit shows its submit window and my_tracked_clips reads its views and what it will pay. posted_at sets when it went up (default now). The same link for the same campaign is one entry.

campaign_id.description: The campaign it was made for (id from rank_clipping_campaigns or plan_my_clips); leave out to track views only

posted_at.description: When it was published, ISO 8601 (default now)

url.description: The post's link: tiktok.com/@name/video/… or a YouTube Shorts link

name: track_my_clip
title: Track a clip the user posted outside heistclips
